attributes.board_name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Veterinary Medicine

rules.accepted_credit_types: RACE; other states' veterinary boards; governmental agencies; AVMA-approved veterinary schools; AVMA, any state VMA or other Board-designated organizations; also authorship, first-time teaching (2 units per unit), academic courses, residency or approved internship
rules.alternatives: Board may waive or extend for health, disability, out-of-state military service or undue hardship (written request).
rules.notes: 15 units during the prior calendar year as a condition of license renewal. Max 6 hours non-interactive instruction. 1 unit = 50 minutes.
